requirements.statement: Implement the adapter as a distinct component through SchedulerAdapter injection without embedding Codex transport in scheduler or deterministic kernel modules.
Implement documented local stdio app-server launch/connect, initialize/initialized handshake, initialization observation, account/read inspection, and truthful live smoke reporting.
Implement documented thread/start and thread/resume operations.
Implement bounded turn/start submission and deterministic lifecycle/item event parsing.
Implement fail-safe timeout, malformed/partial frame, unexpected-exit, and clean shutdown handling.
Detect and surface protocol/method/capability mismatches without silent continuation or crash.
Preserve native KEEL behavior when App Server is unavailable.
Preserve ZERO_INCREMENTAL_COST and prohibit credential, API, billing, fallback, rotation, and evasion surfaces.
Keep experimental transport/process-control paths absent from the load-bearing baseline.
Gate every model-executing adapter action with runtime_authorization ZERO_INCREMENTAL_COST preflight.
Keep keel run bounded to its existing substrate and document the canonical adapter and superseded active plan state.
